use_cases.name: Complete Onboarding Checklist
use_cases.description: New hire views and tracks all required onboarding tasks with due dates

use_cases.name: Submit Required Documents
use_cases.description: New hire uploads and e-signs I-9, W-4, and direct deposit forms

use_cases.name: Review Team Introduction
use_cases.description: New hire views team member profiles with photos and roles

use_cases.name: Provision IT Accounts
use_cases.description: IT administrator or system automatically creates email, Slack, and SaaS tool accounts for new hire

use_cases.name: Monitor Onboarding Progress
use_cases.description: HR administrator views dashboard of new hire task completion and document submission status

use_cases.name: Retrieve Employee Data
use_cases.description: System fetches new hire information from Workday to pre-populate onboarding forms

use_cases.name: Authenticate via SSO
use_cases.description: New hire logs in using Azure AD credentials

use_cases.name: Collect E-signatures
use_cases.description: New hire electronically signs required documents via integrated e-signature service
